identity.high_res_geometry: each high-res branch independently resizes the native PIL image; same 7/8 FOV as the 448->392 baseline
identity.position_interpolation: DINOv2 interpolate_pos_encoding; ViTill side derived from token count

stage1_baseline_comparison.note: Our baseline forward uses effective batch 4; stage 1 used batch 16. Tiny numerical differences are expected.
